# PixMinima's coefficient transcoder

This is the lossless transcode subset of **smallpeg 0.15.0**, distributed under MIT or Apache-2.0. The original licence texts and third-party notices accompany this source. The fork has no dependencies and forbids unsafe Rust. [Upstream source](https://github.com/sawapi/smallpeg) · [Original crate](https://crates.io/crates/smallpeg/0.15.0)

Retained modules implement baseline and progressive Huffman parsing and writing, sparse symbol traversal, frame dimensions, EXIF orientation and metadata positioning. The lossy encoder, pixel decoder, resizing, trellis quantizer, orientation transforms and example program are omitted.

PixMinima adds a progressive scan planner in `src/scan_search.rs`. It searches spectral band partitions by dynamic programming, prices alternative successive approximation depths, and trains the cost estimate on short contiguous runs distributed across each image. The selected bands are measured again on all coefficients, with fresh Huffman tables. A per-scan search permutes equal-length Huffman code assignments to reduce escaped FF bytes. Each candidate competes on its actual encoded length. The writer compares the actual output against the upstream progressive script and baseline candidate. `same_coefficients` compares the visible block grids, quantizers, sampling geometry and component identifiers after transcoding. PixMinima separately checks the output pixels and metadata.

The Maximum preset also searches a denser grid of 37 spectral boundaries and uses up to 4,096 sampled blocks per component for its cost estimates. Thorough keeps its existing 23 boundaries and 1,024-block sample. Maximum tests the four persistent AC Huffman slots and measures the actual encoded bytes before reusing a compatible table across scans. The additional result competes against the verified Thorough result after Huffman table headers have been compacted.

`requantize_jpeg_with` is a separate, opt-in operation. For supported grayscale and three-component JPEGs it rounds dequantized AC coefficients to the nearest representable value on fixed target grids. The target comes from the T.81 Annex K example quantizers and the immutable source DC quantizer. Coarser source entries, the first six zigzag frequencies, frame sampling and marker payloads are retained. A second application has no further quantizer changes. The caller independently decodes the complete original and proposed images, and checks peak error, per-channel MSE and 8×8 local MSE before accepting a smaller file.
